description: A heap of cumulus: a shower's cloud, and the fair-weather cumulus and an island's cap. Places and radii are shares of the cloud's size (a shower's radius, a fair cumulus's), heights shares of its height above its base, as it stands now. A layer grows as the cloud strength goes from grow's first to its second; tone runs from the dark base (0) to the white top (1).
